name: PiP Toggle (FluentFlyout companion)
description: Toggles picture-in-picture for the video that is playing in this browser, and lets the browser open it by itself when you switch away from the tab. The shortcut Ctrl+Shift+6 is global, so FluentFlyout can trigger it while the browser is in the background.

toggle-pip.description: Toggle picture-in-picture for the playing video
